page.overview:
What is Explosive Grub?

The Explosive Grubs were a type of creature native to the planet Genna. When stimulated, they exploded. The Dek handled some by binding them in the leaves the grubs were lying on, along with a number of Spike Pods both were used by as components for improvised mines to defeat a number of Weyland-Yutani Corporation synthetics.
